Tagline: Make and publish 3D games with the first AI game engine
Description: The first all-in-one, AI-native game engine. An AI agent builds your AAA-style 3D game. You can edit it directly in a synced visual editor. No code. Auto-rigging, multiplayer, and 1-click publish built in. Uses ~80% fewer tokens and generates faster than Claude Opus 5.5 + Unity.

2. Floot Payments

Tagline: Take payments in apps you build in ChatGPT and Claude
Description: Floot apps can now take real money. Ask your AI in ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor for “a $9/month plan”, “a checkout for this course” or “shipping labels for my orders”, and Floot sets it up: subscriptions with a billing page, one-time payments, tickets and deposits, coupons and refunds, plus shipping with live rates, labels and tracking. Runs on Stripe, no API keys or webhooks. Test free in preview, go live when you publish.

Tagline: A computer for every agent

Your agent can also run your app with Docker Compose to test its changes. You decide which domains each sandbox can reach. When your agent goes idle, the sandbox suspends and compute charges stop.
